normalization.n1_store_root: occurrences of filepath.Clean(store argument) in the error text are replaced by @STORE; nothing is replaced when the cleaned argument is "." (Go then prints bare relative names); an un-cleaned spelling is not rewritten
normalization.n2_gpg_version_drift: only for version_variant cases and only when the replaying `gpg --version` first line differs from oracle.gpg_version: lines equal to an optional_stderr_lines entry are removed and consecutive identical lines collapsed, on both sides; otherwise the error text is compared byte for byte
normalization.gpg_stderr_reaching_go: success: gpg stderr is discarded; failure: error = "decrypt pass entry <path>: " + strings.TrimSpace(stderr) (or err.Error() when stderr is empty)
normalization.store_forms: the store argument is spelled plain, with a trailing slash, a doubled slash, a ./ segment, a parent segment, relative, ./relative or as "." (cwd inside the store) so Go's path.Join cleaning of printed paths is pinned
normalization.two_run_check: every case is evaluated twice against the real Go importer and any difference fails generation
